<h2>Load the Prior Local Prepared-Fold Object</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Reads the prior local object without consulting target metadata during
target execution. Missing, unreadable or non-list objects return NULL.
Analytical cache eligibility remains owned by
[prepare_sjsdm_tuning_folds()], which reconstructs current inputs first.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>load_sjsdm_prepared_fold_cache(
  file_cache = targets::tar_path_target(store = targets::tar_path_store()),
  read_cache_function = qs2::qs_read
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="file_cache">file_cache</code></td>
<td>
<p>Local object path. The default uses the documented current-target path
with the running store; outside target execution it resolves to NA.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="read_cache_function">read_cache_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable file reader accepting a named file argument. Defaults to the
project's qs2 reader, compatible with its current local qs target objects.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>The prior list object or NULL. No target metadata are changed.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>load_sjsdm_prepared_fold_cache(file_cache = "missing-fold-cache.qs")
</code></pre>
